package pfound

// F looks for 3.
func F(xs []int) int {
	n := 0
	found := false
	found = scan(xs, found)
	if found {
		n = 1
	}
	return n
}

// scan is part of F, extracted by my_editor.
func scan(xs []int, found bool) bool {
	for _, x := range xs {
		if x == 3 {
			found = true
		}
	}
	return found
}
